slices.focus: The dispensing overhaul moves from review to active pilot with Peter's approval
slices.summary: Saira turns six weeks of evidence (delay notes, photos, timestamps) into a live pilot: splitting repeat prescriptions from acute walk-ins, relabeling back-room sections, and installing a midday prep board. She develops staff and patient scripts and defines three pilot measures.
open_loops: Amelia's resistance to perceived slowdown needs ongoing management
Staff may bypass the staging board when busy
Pilot success criteria not yet formally defined with Peter
First messy week could trigger abandonment of the trial
decisions: Saira moved from reviewing dispensing flow problems to actively piloting a new workflow at Westgate Pharmacy with separa

slices.focus: Wedding postponed to next year after a renovation argument reveals unrealistic timelines
slices.summary: After another argument about budget, dust, and timelines, Saira and Tom mutually agree to postpone their wedding into next year. They establish a stricter rule about booking and spending decisions together, and plan weekly budget check-ins with three headings.
open_loops: Reassessment month for wedding date needs to be set
House livable threshold (kitchen usable, bedroom calm, front room clear) not yet achieved
Saira needs to practice flagging vague plans earlier with Tom
decisions: Saira and Tom mutually postponed their wedding into next year after another renovation-related argument.
